cards.target: Vi har ofta undrat.
cards.english: We have often wondered.

cards.target: Jag har ibland tvekat.
cards.english: I have sometimes hesitated.

cards.target: De har verkligen imponerat.
cards.english: They have really impressed.

cards.target: Vi har knappast hunnit.
cards.english: We have barely had time.

cards.target: Tåget avgår klockan 14:35.
cards.english: The train departs at 14:35.

cards.target: Vi har definitivt bestämt oss.
cards.english: We have definitely decided.

cards.target: Vi har praktiskt taget avslutat.
cards.english: We have practically finished.

cards.target: Jag har alltid gillat Sverige.
cards.english: I have always liked Sweden.

cards.target: Jag har förmodligen haft fel.
cards.english: I have probably been wrong.

cards.target: Vad han sa förvånade oss.
cards.english: What he said surprised us.

cards.target: Henne har jag aldrig träffat.
cards.english: Her I have never met.

cards.target: Gång på gång försökte han.
cards.english: Time and again he tried.

cards.target: Skogen stod tyst och stilla.
cards.english: The forest stood quiet and still.

cards.target: De har i alla fall försökt.
cards.english: They have at least tried.

cards.target: Annorlunda hade det inte kunnat bli.
cards.english: It couldn't have been any different.

cards.target: Var vi än går följer naturen.
cards.english: Wherever we go, nature is there.

cards.target: Jag har antagligen gjort ett misstag.
cards.english: I have probably made a mistake.

cards.target: Till dig har jag en present.
cards.english: For you I have a present.

cards.target: När som helst kan det hända.
cards.english: It can happen at any time.

cards.target: Jag har med säkerhet sett det förut.
cards.english: I have certainly seen it before.

cards.target: I Sverige bor det tio miljoner människor.
cards.english: Ten million people live in Sweden.

cards.target: Sedan dess har jag inte sett henne.
cards.english: Since then I haven't seen her.

cards.target: Vacker som dagen var gick vi ut.
cards.english: Because the day was beautiful, we went out.

cards.target: Kan du hjälpa mig på morgonen också?
cards.english: Can you help me in the morning too?

cards.target: Vilken dag det var i helgen redan!
cards.english: What a day we had on the weekend!

cards.target: Det finns inget dåligt väder, bara dåliga kläder.
cards.english: There's no bad weather, only bad clothes.

cards.target: Vi har redan ätit frukost innan vi gick ut på promenaden.
cards.english: We had already eaten breakfast before we went for our walk.

cards.target: Han har äntligen kommit.
cards.english: He has finally arrived.

cards.target: Härmed bekräftas er bokning.
cards.english: Hereby your booking is confirmed.

cards.target: Springa orkar jag inte.
cards.english: Run I can't be bothered to.

cards.target: Det är ingalunda säkert.
cards.english: It is by no means certain.

cards.target: Vi har helt enkelt tur.
cards.english: We simply have luck.

cards.target: Hon har till slut lyckats.
cards.english: She has finally succeeded.

cards.target: De orden glömmer jag aldrig.
cards.english: Those words I will never forget.

cards.target: Bara tillsammans klarar vi det.
cards.english: Only together can we manage it.

cards.target: Jag syns inte i mörkret.
cards.english: I cannot be seen in the dark.

cards.target: Steg för steg lärde hon sig.
cards.english: Step by step she learned.

cards.target: Enbart genom samarbete kan vi lyckas.
cards.english: Only through cooperation can we succeed.

cards.target: Sällan har jag ätit så gott.
cards.english: Seldom have I eaten so well.

cards.target: Hennes röst bar spår av smärta.
cards.english: Her voice carried traces of pain.

cards.target: De har tydligen glömt bort mötet.
cards.english: They have apparently forgotten about the meeting.

cards.target: Jag har länge velat besöka Gotland.
cards.english: I have long wanted to visit Gotland.

cards.target: Det gamla hjulet knarrade i vinden.
cards.english: The old wheel creaked in the wind.

cards.target: Vindruteputsaren klättrade uppför den höga skyskrapan.
cards.english: The window cleaner climbed up the tall skyscraper.

cards.target: Vad du än säger lyssnar hon inte.
cards.english: Whatever you say, she doesn't listen.

cards.target: Han vandrade ensam genom den töckenhöljda dalen.
cards.english: He walked alone through the misty valley.

cards.target: Hennes ögon avslöjade det hon inte sa.
cards.english: Her eyes revealed what she didn't say.

cards.target: Knäckebröd finns i alla svenska hushåll här.
cards.english: Crispbread can be found in every Swedish household.

cards.target: Det kan inte uteslutas just nu också.
cards.english: It cannot be excluded right now too.

cards.target: Problemet löstes snabbt just nu under sommaren.
cards.english: The problem was solved quickly that summer.

cards.target: Var som helst i Sverige hittar man sjöar.
cards.english: Anywhere in Sweden you can find lakes.

cards.target: Fjällen reste sig majestätiskt mot skyarna förra året.
cards.english: The mountains rose majestically against the skies.

cards.target: Solnedgången målade himlen i alla nyanser av rött.
cards.english: The sunset painted the sky in all shades of red.

cards.target: Tidens tand hade nött på de gamla murarna.
cards.english: The tooth of time had worn away at the old walls.

cards.target: Vi kramas vid avskedet på kvällen med vänner.
cards.english: We exchange hugs at the farewell in the evening with friends.

cards.target: Upp gick solen över bergen och hela dalen badades i ljus.
cards.english: Up went the sun over the mountains and the whole valley was bathed in light.

cards.target: Lövträden susade i aftonbrisen.
cards.english: The deciduous trees rustled in the evening breeze.

cards.target: Det anser jag vara felaktigt.
cards.english: That I consider to be incorrect.

cards.target: Enslingen hade valt skogens ensamhet.
cards.english: The recluse had chosen the forest's solitude.

cards.target: Bara i Sverige finns denna tradition.
cards.english: Only in Sweden does this tradition exist.
